note: The hulking thing that is not wildlife and is not a large man. It is here to be an argument a sword does not settle, so that the kit sold for surviving one — a warding draught, a shield, a head start — has something to be for.

What decides how a fight with it goes is in properties/monsters.json, with the argument for each number beside it. The numbers here are not that: they are a shape, and a shape is read by looking at it rather than by being told.

parts.note: Short legs set well under the mass, so the whole animal reads as weight rather than height.
The hump: from an isometric camera this is most of the silhouette, and it is what says "not a large man" at the distance you still have time to turn round at.
The log it carries, swinging with the arm that holds it: the warning arrives before it does.
